text:
release-coordinator: Heads-up: starting deploy for release/2026.03.15 now. Canary 5% us-west, hold EU until canary green. Change window 12:00-12:30 UTC. Please confirm backout/runbook is reachable and DB migration toggle is ready. @kevin @maria_sre @ops_anna

deploy-bot: CI ✅ all checks passed, canary job cb-411223 started at 12:02 UTC. Logs: https://ci.internal/411223 (artifact -> release-2026.03.15). Notifying watchers.

kevin: ack — watching metrics (5xx, latency P95). Quick checklist: heap snapshots enabled, cache flush paths staged, and metrics alert thresholds set to canary thresholds.

maria_sre: Confirmed backout runbook link and playbook pinned in runbooks repo: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/deploy-backout-2026 (section: db-toggle, traffic-shift, unpin). I've added a note about stateful migration rollback steps.

ops_anna: DB migration toggle is present behind feature-flag: feature_flag.db_migrate_2026_03. Toggle can be flipped from the ops console or via api. I can flip manually if we see errors.

release-coordinator: Good — two asks: 1) If canary failure => immediate unpin + traffic shift to previous release. 2) If DB issue => flip feature_flag.db_migrate_2026_03 to OFF and abort remaining canaries. We should publish the rollback join link for oncall.

devex-liz: Posted rollback conference room + runbook snippets in the incident playbook: https://ops.internal/rooms/rollback-411223. Also added these quick commands for oncall:```sh
# emergency unpin + abort canary
deploybot unpin --release release/2026.03.15
deploybot abort-canary --id cb-411223 --reason "canary-failure"
# traffic shift back to previous stable
trafficctl shift --to release/2026.03.14 --percent 100
```

kevin: capturing acceptance criteria for canary green: P95 latency <= 250ms, error rate < 0.5%, no data migration errors in db-migrate logs. If any of these breach for >2m, we cut.

maria_sre: + add: check replica lag on all DB replicas < 50ms before rolling further; if lag above threshold, do not proceed and flip toggle.

deploy-bot: Canary metrics feed: https://metrics.internal/cb-411223 (alerts wired). Current snapshot: P95=210ms, errors=0.12%, replica_lag=22ms.

ops_anna: I'll be on the console for the next 30m. If I flip the toggle, I'll post here immediately.

release-coordinator: Small change: EU hold still in place. Plan: if canary green at 10m mark, we go to 25% eu-west with a second canary. If anything odd, we follow the backout runbook and revert.

kevin: Noted. Adding a short postmortem TODO to runbooks if we end up rolling back so we capture metrics before/after.

maria_sre: One more preflight: backup of migrations schema snapshot id: schema-snap-20260315-1200 created. Link: https://db.internal/snapshots/schema-snap-20260315-1200. We're safe to proceed.

deploy-bot: Canary passed 10m health checks. Moving to stage: roll to 25% us-west. cb-411223 -> cb-411224.

release-coordinator: thanks. keeping watch. If anyone sees sustained errors file a high priority alert and call the rollback room. :rotating_light:

ops_anna: flipping fingers. :crossed_fingers:

(30s later)

kevin: noticed tail of a stacktrace in canary logs referencing db transaction timeout — investigating now.

maria_sre: I see a spike in replica lag on one replica; raising to ops to consider flipping the toggle.

ops_anna: flipping feature_flag.db_migrate_2026_03 -> OFF now. Posting actions.

ops_anna: feature_flag.db_migrate_2026_03 is OFF. Confirming abort of remaining canaries and beginning rollback per runbook.

deploy-bot: Received abort request. Executing: abort-canary cb-411224; unpin release/2026.03.15; initiating traffic shift back to release/2026.03.14. Commands executed at 12:12:03 UTC. See logs: https://ci.internal/411223/rollback-logs.

release-coordinator: All right — follow the backout runbook steps in the wiki (db-toggle, traffic shift, cache invalidation). Assigning postmortem owner: @kevin. Please collect metrics and message TLs.

kevin: Will own the postmortem. I'll capture comparison graphs (P95, error rate, replica lag) and timeline.

maria_sre: Leaving a note in runbook: add a step to fail canary faster on replica lag for next run.

devex-liz: I updated the runbook with the new note and a short copy/paste snippet for emergency toggles. https://wiki.internal/runbooks/deploy-backout-2026#notes

release-coordinator: Thank you all. Ending thread when postmortem is filed.

ops_anna: standing down but on call for followups.

deploy-bot: Deploy status: ROLLED BACK -> release/2026.03.15 unpinned, traffic at release/2026.03.14 100%.

kevin: filing postmortem now. Expect draft in 2 hours.

maria_sre: closing checklist: schema snapshot retained, feature flag OFF, runbook updated.

release-coordinator: Good job. We'll re-run preflight checklist before attempting another rollout. :thumbsup:
